_note: Consistent 3-shot set for Aldric Fenn (Wayward Compass guildmaster, Millhaven-born human). The 'full' shot is the text-to-image anchor; 'portrait' and 'office' reference it so he stays one person. Regenerate locally (Claude-operated, npc-art skill): python3 tools/imageGen/npc_art.py set --spec <this file> --force (variations/upscale stages: see tools/imageGen/README.md).
character: a large weathered human man in his late fifties, a bear of a man, heavy through the shoulders and a little slower than he was; a salt-and-pepper beard kept slightly unkempt, story-telling scars, the weather-creased face of a man who grew up where the river wind comes off a port; direct, warm-eyed, carrying a quiet tiredness
wardrobe: a practical worn guildmaster's coat and boots resoled more times than replaced, a guildmaster's medallion on a chain tucked under the collar so only the chain shows
style: Painterly semi-realistic fantasy character illustration, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, muted earthy palette, warm low key, dark desaturated vignette background, no text, no frame, no watermark.

full.framing: Full-length character study, standing settled and square with weight on his heels, one hand near a shortsword resting on a cluttered desk; plain dark studio backdrop.

portrait.framing: A tightly cropped head-and-shoulders portrait: head and tops of the shoulders fill the frame, the weathered scarred face and salt-and-pepper beard, a guarded warmth in the eyes, the medallion chain just visible at the collar. Close, intimate framing; only the head and shoulders, not the full body.

office.framing: Three-quarter view in a cramped top-floor guildmaster's office, river-window light on one side, a shortsword and paper-strewn desk, leaning back in a worn chair with a cup of something dark, the weight of the most powerful organisation in the world resting on a small-town desk.
